tagline: A job-search CRM with AI studios that turn your projects, skills and voice into tailored resumes, cover letters and application answers — designed as TSX you can edit.
summary: Code Your Resume tracks the job hunt — companies, jobs, applications, employment history and application questions — and keeps the material an AI needs to write about you: projects with notes, a technical skills list, LinkedIn history and a voice/tone note.

From any job it generates job-specific graphics: resumes, skills components and US Letter cover letters as TSX that open in the Graphics Studio for live preview and PNG export. **Quick apply** on the dashboard takes a company URL and a job listing URL, scrapes both, creates the CRM rows and queues resume generation in one step. Everything is stored in local Postgres through the Express API.
audience: You're actively job-hunting and applying to many roles that each need a tailored resume and cover letter.
You want your work history captured once (projects, skills, voice) and reused by AI for every application.
You're comfortable with code-defined documents (TSX + Tailwind) and running Postgres locally.
notFor: Recruiters managing candidates — it's a single job-seeker's CRM with no multi-user auth.
A hosted resume builder — it runs locally; AI generation needs your own Anthropic and Cursor keys.
Applying on your behalf — it prepares materials; you still submit applications.

capabilities.title: Job-search CRM
capabilities.detail: `/companies`, `/jobs`, `/job-questions` and their detail pages track companies, employees, jobs, applications and employment (`/api/data/<entity>/<action>`).

capabilities.title: Job Studio
capabilities.detail: `/job-detail-page` shows listing bullets, an **At a glance** summary, job-scoped graphics, the applications log and a coach chat.

capabilities.title: Quick apply
capabilities.detail: On `/dashboard`, paste a company URL and job URL; `POST /api/data/quick-apply/run` scrapes both, creates rows and queues resume generation.

capabilities.title: Graphics Studio
capabilities.detail: `/studio` edits TSX graphics (resumes, cover letters) with in-browser compile, live preview and PNG export.

capabilities.title: Cover letters
capabilities.detail: **Generate cover letter** on a job produces an 816×1056 TSX letter via a Cursor Cloud Agent and saves it as a graphic.

capabilities.title: Experience studios
capabilities.detail: `/experience/projects` (projects + notes, AI-synthesized), `/experience/studio` (technical skills with coach chat) and `/experience/voice` (tone notes) feed every generation.

capabilities.title: My LinkedIn
capabilities.detail: `/my-linkedin` syncs your profile, jobs, education and certifications via Apify.

capabilities.title: Job newsletters
capabilities.detail: `/job-newsletters` pulls job emails from Email Manager and extracts listings with AI.

capabilities.title: AI prompts, costs and docs
capabilities.detail: `/ai-prompts`, `/ai-costs`, and `/docs` (getting started, TSX security, API reference from `GET /api-docs.json`).

components.name: Web app
components.owns: Marketing landing, the CRM and studio UIs, TSX preview/export and in-app docs. Next rewrites `/api/data/*`, `/api/technical-skills/*`, `/api/voice-style/*` and `/api/job-studio/*` to Express.

components.name: API
components.owns: Local Postgres `code_your_resume` (`migrations/setup.sql`), all CRM and studio CRUD, AI extraction/research/coach chat (Anthropic), cover letter and skills generation (Cursor Cloud Agents), LinkedIn sync (Apify), job newsletter ingest, error log and AI ledgers.

dataFlow: Create `code_your_resume` and run `migrations/setup.sql`; Express connects with `DATABASE_URL`.
The browser calls same-origin `/api/*`; Next rewrites to Express (`EXPRESS_API_URL`, default `http://127.0.0.1:3053`).
Quick apply and job import scrape the listing and company site, and Anthropic extracts bullets and an At-a-glance summary.

Resume/cover letter generation builds context from projects, notes, skills and voice, then asks a Cursor Cloud Agent working in `CURSOR_TARGET_REPO` to write the TSX, which is saved as an image graphic.
LinkedIn sync calls Apify; job newsletters are pulled from Email Manager (`EMAIL_MANAGER_EXPRESS_URL`).

trust.title: Browser
trust.detail: No secrets. TSX in the studio is compiled and run in your browser — treat it as trusted code (see `/docs/security/tsx-preview`).

trust.title: Express (your machine)
trust.detail: Holds `DATABASE_URL`, `ANTHROPIC_API_KEY`, `CURSOR_API_KEY`, `APIFY_API_TOKEN`. Binds to 127.0.0.1 locally. No auth unless `CRM_API_SECRET` is set.

trust.title: Third parties
trust.detail: Anthropic gets listing text and your background; Cursor gets generation prompts and writes to your target repo; Apify fetches your LinkedIn profile.

commonTasks.title: First-time setup
steps: On the **API Express** repo, **Set up local database** (or `createdb code_your_resume && psql "$DATABASE_URL" -f migrations/setup.sql`).
Set `DATABASE_URL`, and optionally `ANTHROPIC_API_KEY`, `CURSOR_API_KEY` + `CURSOR_TARGET_REPO`, `APIFY_API_TOKEN` in the API's Environment step.
On the **Web** repo, set `EXPRESS_API_URL` to the API's port if it isn't 3053.

commonTasks.title: Fill in your background
steps: Build your skills list with the coach at `/experience/studio`.
Write tone notes at `/experience/voice`, and optionally sync `/my-linkedin`.
Generation requires at least projects or a voice note.

commonTasks.title: Apply to a job
steps: Use **Quick apply** on `/dashboard` with the company and job URLs, or create the job by hand and paste the description.
Open the job, review the bullets and At a glance summary.
Generate a resume and cover letter, then fine-tune them in the Graphics Studio and export PNGs.
Log the application on the job.

commonTasks.title: Enable Cursor-based generation
commonTasks.when: Generate resume / cover letter buttons fail.
steps: Create a Cursor API key at cursor.com/settings and set `CURSOR_API_KEY`.
Set `CURSOR_TARGET_REPO` to the **web** repo (it has the `.cursor/architecture` the agent follows), install the Cursor GitHub App on it.
Long runs can take up to 20 minutes (`CURSOR_AGENT_MAX_WAIT_MS`).

troubleshooting.fix: Express isn't on the port Next expects. Default is 3053; set `EXPRESS_API_URL` on the web if Hub runs the API elsewhere.

troubleshooting.symptom: API fails at boot or data routes 500
troubleshooting.fix: `DATABASE_URL` missing or migrations not applied. Run `migrations/setup.sql`.
`CRM_API_SECRET` is set on Express but not on Next (or they differ).
Add at least one project or a voice note.
Check the Cursor key, repo authorization and GitHub App; the Next proxy allows 300s, the agent poll up to 20 min.
Set `APIFY_API_TOKEN` and save your profile URL first.

glossary.definition: A TSX document (resume, cover letter, skills component) stored in `image_graphics` and edited in the studio.
The job detail page: listing bullets, graphics, applications and coach chat.
One-shot pipeline from two URLs to CRM rows plus queued resume generation.
A single tone note (`voice_style`) included in every AI generation.

hubNotes: The API defaults to port 3053 but the registry says `defaultApiPort: 3014`. The web falls back to 3053 when `EXPRESS_API_URL` is unset — set it if Hub runs the API on 3014.
The web README and several web ADRs (008, 013, 014, 021) still describe Supabase; the API moved to local Postgres (express ADR 012). Trust the express README.
The registry has no `localDatabase` entry, so **Set up local database** may not be offered — create `code_your_resume` and run `migrations/setup.sql` by hand.
Job newsletters need the Email Manager express running (`EMAIL_MANAGER_EXPRESS_URL`, default port 3051).
